messages.content: Buffalo is eating less and feels warm.
Since when did this start, and is there any nasal discharge or coughing?
Started yesterday, no coughing, slight nasal wetness.
Monitor temperature every 6-8 hours, keep hydration up, and contact a vet if fever rises or breathing changes.

summary: Buffalo low appetite with mild fever

messages.content: Goat has loose motion for two days.
Is there blood in stool, and has feed recently changed?
No blood. Feed changed three days ago.
Return gradually to previous feed, provide clean water with electrolytes, and call a vet if weakness or blood appears.

summary: Goat loose stool after feed change
